title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 73
description: Ten questions on Psalms 73: envy of the prosperous wicked, a turning point in God's sanctuary, and God as the strength of the heart.

questions.text: To whom is God good, according to verse 1?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says: "Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart."

answers.text: To those who are pure in heart
To those who are rich in goods
To those who are strong in battle
To those who are wise in counsel

questions.text: What did the speaker see that made him envious of the arrogant?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says he was envious of the arrogant when he saw the prosperity of the wicked.

questions.text: What is like a chain around the neck of the wicked?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says: "Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck."

questions.text: What question do the wicked ask in verse 11?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says they ask, "How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?"

questions.text: In what does the speaker say he washed his hands?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says he cleansed his heart in vain and washed his hands in innocence.

questions.text: Where did the speaker enter before he considered the latter end of the wicked?
questions.explanation: Verses 16-17 say understanding this was too painful for him until he entered God's sanctuary and considered their latter end.

questions.text: Like what will the Lord despise their fantasies when he awakes?
questions.explanation: Verse 20 says: "As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies."

answers.text: As a dream when one wakes up
As chaff on the threshing floor

questions.text: What does the speaker say he was before God?
questions.explanation: Verse 22 says: "I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you."

questions.text: Besides the strength of his heart, what does the speaker call God in verse 26?
questions.explanation: Verse 26 says God is the strength of his heart and his portion forever.

questions.text: What does the speaker say is good for him?
questions.explanation: Verse 28 says: "But it is good for me to come close to God."

answers.text: To be at ease like the wicked
